title: Single Conveyor Station CAEX Hierarchy
description: IEC 62714 AutomationML (CAEX 2.15) plant topology modeling an automated conveyor belt station and PLC drive controller with 6-DOF spatial frame, signal interfaces, and typed internal links.
code:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<CAEXFile FileName="conveyor_station.aml" SchemaVersion="2.15">
  <InstanceHierarchy Name="ConveyorStation">
    <Version>1.0.0</Version>
    <InternalElement Name="InfeedConveyor" ID="conv-01">
      <Attribute Name="beltLength" AttributeDataType="xs:double" Unit="m">
        <Value>4.5</Value>
      </Attribute>
      <Attribute Name="maxSpeed" AttributeDataType="xs:double" Unit="m/s">
        <Value>1.8</Value>
      </Attribute>
      <Attribute Name="Frame">
        <Attribute Name="x" AttributeDataType="xs:double"><Value>0.0</Value></Attribute>
        <Attribute Name="y" AttributeDataType="xs:double"><Value>0.0</Value></Attribute>
        <Attribute Name="z" AttributeDataType="xs:double"><Value>0.85</Value></Attribute>
        <Attribute Name="rx" AttributeDataType="xs:double"><Value>0.0</Value></Attribute>
        <Attribute Name="ry" AttributeDataType="xs:double"><Value>0.0</Value></Attribute>
        <Attribute Name="rz" AttributeDataType="xs:double"><Value>0.0</Value></Attribute>
      </Attribute>
      <ExternalInterface Name="motorCmd" ID="conv-01-cmd" RefBaseClassPath="AutomationMLInterfaceClassLib/AutomationMLBaseInterface/SignalInterface" Direction="In" DataType="BOOL" />
      <ExternalInterface Name="partDetected" ID="conv-01-det" RefBaseClassPath="AutomationMLInterfaceClassLib/AutomationMLBaseInterface/SignalInterface" Direction="Out" DataType="BOOL" />
      <RoleRequirements RefBaseRoleClassPath="AutomationMLBaseRoleClassLib/AutomationMLBaseRole/Resource" />
    </InternalElement>
    <InternalElement Name="StationPLC" ID="plc-01">
      <Attribute Name="scanCycleMs" AttributeDataType="xs:double" Unit="ms">
        <Value>10.0</Value>
      </Attribute>
      <ExternalInterface Name="driveStart" ID="plc-01-start" RefBaseClassPath="AutomationMLInterfaceClassLib/AutomationMLBaseInterface/SignalInterface" Direction="Out" DataType="BOOL" />
      <ExternalInterface Name="sensorIn" ID="plc-01-sens" RefBaseClassPath="AutomationMLInterfaceClassLib/AutomationMLBaseInterface/SignalInterface" Direction="In" DataType="BOOL" />
      <InternalLink Name="MotorCommandLink" RefPartnerSideA="plc-01:driveStart" RefPartnerSideB="conv-01:motorCmd" />
      <InternalLink Name="PhotoEyeLink" RefPartnerSideA="conv-01:partDetected" RefPartnerSideB="plc-01:sensorIn" />
      <RoleRequirements RefBaseRoleClassPath="AutomationMLBaseRoleClassLib/AutomationMLBaseRole/Resource" />
    </InternalElement>
  </InstanceHierarchy>
  <InterfaceClassLib Name="AutomationMLInterfaceClassLib">
    <InterfaceClass Name="AutomationMLBaseInterface" />
    <InterfaceClass Name="SignalInterface" RefBaseClassPath="AutomationMLInterfaceClassLib/AutomationMLBaseInterface" />
  </InterfaceClassLib>
  <RoleClassLib Name="AutomationMLBaseRoleClassLib">
    <RoleClass Name="AutomationMLBaseRole" />
    <RoleClass Name="Resource" RefBaseClassPath="AutomationMLBaseRoleClassLib/AutomationMLBaseRole" />
  </RoleClassLib>
</CAEXFile>

title: Robotic Pick-and-Place Workcell with Kinematical Ports
description: Six-axis industrial pick-and-place robotic workcell with 6-DOF spatial mounting frames, vacuum gripper attachment ports, vision trigger interface, and cell controller links.
code:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<CAEXFile FileName="pick_and_place.aml" SchemaVersion="2.15">
  <InstanceHierarchy Name="PickAndPlaceCell">
    <Version>1.0.0</Version>
    <InternalElement Name="RobotArm01" ID="rob-01" RefBaseSystemUnitPath="WorkcellUnits/SixAxisRobot">
      <Attribute Name="payloadKg" AttributeDataType="xs:double" Unit="kg"><Value>10.0</Value></Attribute>
      <Attribute Name="Frame">
        <Attribute Name="x" AttributeDataType="xs:double"><Value>1.20</Value></Attribute>
        <Attribute Name="y" AttributeDataType="xs:double"><Value>0.80</Value></Attribute>
        <Attribute Name="z" AttributeDataType="xs:double"><Value>0.00</Value></Attribute>
        <Attribute Name="rx" AttributeDataType="xs:double"><Value>0</Value></Attribute>
        <Attribute Name="ry" AttributeDataType="xs:double"><Value>0</Value></Attribute>
        <Attribute Name="rz" AttributeDataType="xs:double"><Value>45</Value></Attribute>
      </Attribute>
      <ExternalInterface Name="toolFlange" ID="rob-01-flange" RefBaseClassPath="WorkcellInterfaces/AttachmentInterface" />
      <ExternalInterface Name="cycleStart" ID="rob-01-start" RefBaseClassPath="WorkcellInterfaces/SignalInterface" Direction="In" DataType="BOOL" />
      <ExternalInterface Name="cycleDone" ID="rob-01-done" RefBaseClassPath="WorkcellInterfaces/SignalInterface" Direction="Out" DataType="BOOL" />
      <RoleRequirements RefBaseRoleClassPath="WorkcellRoles/RobotResource" />
    </InternalElement>
    <InternalElement Name="VacuumGripper01" ID="grip-01" RefBaseSystemUnitPath="WorkcellUnits/GripperUnit">
      <ExternalInterface Name="mountBase" ID="grip-01-mount" RefBaseClassPath="WorkcellInterfaces/AttachmentInterface" />
      <ExternalInterface Name="suctionCmd" ID="grip-01-cmd" RefBaseClassPath="WorkcellInterfaces/SignalInterface" Direction="In" DataType="BOOL" />
      <RoleRequirements RefBaseRoleClassPath="WorkcellRoles/EndEffector" />
    </InternalElement>
    <InternalElement Name="CellController" ID="ctrl-01" PPRCategory="Resource">
      <ExternalInterface Name="cmdRobotStart" ID="ctrl-01-rstart" RefBaseClassPath="WorkcellInterfaces/SignalInterface" Direction="Out" DataType="BOOL" />
      <ExternalInterface Name="fbRobotDone" ID="ctrl-01-rdone" RefBaseClassPath="WorkcellInterfaces/SignalInterface" Direction="In" DataType="BOOL" />
      <ExternalInterface Name="cmdSuction" ID="ctrl-01-suc" RefBaseClassPath="WorkcellInterfaces/SignalInterface" Direction="Out" DataType="BOOL" />
      <InternalLink Name="Link_FlangeAttach" RefPartnerSideA="rob-01:toolFlange" RefPartnerSideB="grip-01:mountBase" />
      <InternalLink Name="Link_RobotStart" RefPartnerSideA="ctrl-01:cmdRobotStart" RefPartnerSideB="rob-01:cycleStart" />
      <InternalLink Name="Link_RobotDone" RefPartnerSideA="rob-01:cycleDone" RefPartnerSideB="ctrl-01:fbRobotDone" />
      <InternalLink Name="Link_GripperSuction" RefPartnerSideA="ctrl-01:cmdSuction" RefPartnerSideB="grip-01:suctionCmd" />
    </InternalElement>
  </InstanceHierarchy>
  <InterfaceClassLib Name="WorkcellInterfaces">
    <InterfaceClass Name="SignalInterface" />
    <InterfaceClass Name="AttachmentInterface" />
  </InterfaceClassLib>
  <RoleClassLib Name="WorkcellRoles">
    <RoleClass Name="RobotResource" />
    <RoleClass Name="EndEffector" />
  </RoleClassLib>
  <SystemUnitClassLib Name="WorkcellUnits">
    <SystemUnitClass Name="SixAxisRobot">
      <SupportedRoleClass RefRoleClassPath="WorkcellRoles/RobotResource" />
    </SystemUnitClass>
    <SystemUnitClass Name="GripperUnit">
      <SupportedRoleClass RefRoleClassPath="WorkcellRoles/EndEffector" />
    </SystemUnitClass>
  </SystemUnitClassLib>
</CAEXFile>

title: Assembly Cell Referencing External Standard RoleClassLib

      <Attribute Name="cycleTimeSec" AttributeDataType="xs:double" Unit="s">
        <Value>6.5</Value>
      </Attribute>
      <RoleRequirements RefBaseRoleClassPath="AutomationMLBaseRoleClassLib/AutomationMLBaseRole/Process" />
    </InternalElement>
    <InternalElement Name="ServoPressStation" ID="res-press-01">
      <Attribute Name="maxForceKN" AttributeDataType="xs:double" Unit="kN">
        <Value>50.0</Value>
      </Attribute>
      <Attribute Name="Frame">
        <Attribute Name="x" AttributeDataType="xs:double"><Value>2.5</Value></Attribute>
        <Attribute Name="y" AttributeDataType="xs:double"><Value>1.0</Value></Attribute>
        <Attribute Name="z" AttributeDataType="xs:double"><Value>0.0</Value></Attribute>
        <Attribute Name="rx" AttributeDataType="xs:double"><Value>0.0</Value></Attribute>
        <Attribute Name="ry" AttributeDataType="xs:double"><Value>0.0</Value></Attribute>
        <Attribute Name="rz" AttributeDataType="xs:double"><Value>0.0</Value></Attribute>
      </Attribute>
      <ExternalInterface Name="pressStart" ID="res-press-01-start" RefBaseClassPath="AutomationMLInterfaceClassLib/AutomationMLBaseInterface/SignalInterface" Direction="In" DataType="BOOL" />
      <ExternalInterface Name="forceActual" ID="res-press-01-force" RefBaseClassPath="AutomationMLInterfaceClassLib/AutomationMLBaseInterface/SignalInterface" Direction="Out" DataType="REAL" />
      <RoleRequirements RefBaseRoleClassPath="AutomationMLBaseRoleClassLib/AutomationMLBaseRole/Resource" />
    </InternalElement>
    <InternalElement Name="CellController" ID="res-plc-01">
      <ExternalInterface Name="cmdPress" ID="res-plc-01-cmd" RefBaseClassPath="AutomationMLInterfaceClassLib/AutomationMLBaseInterface/SignalInterface" Direction="Out" DataType="BOOL" />
      <ExternalInterface Name="forceFeedback" ID="res-plc-01-fb" RefBaseClassPath="AutomationMLInterfaceClassLib/AutomationMLBaseInterface/SignalInterface" Direction="In" DataType="REAL" />
      <InternalLink Name="PressTrigger" RefPartnerSideA="res-plc-01:cmdPress" RefPartnerSideB="res-press-01:pressStart" />
      <InternalLink Name="ForceMonitor" RefPartnerSideA="res-press-01:forceActual" RefPartnerSideB="res-plc-01:forceFeedback" />
      <RoleRequirements RefBaseRoleClassPath="AutomationMLBaseRoleClassLib/AutomationMLBaseRole/Resource" />
    </InternalElement>
  </InstanceHierarchy>
</CAEXFile>

title: Automotive Body-in-White Welding Line with PLC Signal Interfaces
description: Multi-file IEC 62714 AutomationML automotive body-in-white spot-welding cell referencing an external InterfaceClassLib (interfaces.aml) and a companion IEC 61131-3 PLCopen Structured Text control program (plc_signals.st).
code:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>

  <ExternalReference Path="interfaces.aml" Alias="IfLib" />
  <InstanceHierarchy Name="BIW_SpotWeldingLine">
    <Version>3.1.0</Version>
    <InternalElement Name="SpotWeldRobot_L1" ID="weld-rob-01">
      <Attribute Name="weldCurrentKA" AttributeDataType="xs:double" Unit="kA">
        <Value>11.5</Value>
      </Attribute>
      <Attribute Name="electrodeForceKN" AttributeDataType="xs:double" Unit="kN">
        <Value>4.2</Value>
      </Attribute>
      <Attribute Name="Frame">
        <Attribute Name="x" AttributeDataType="xs:double"><Value>3.0</Value></Attribute>
        <Attribute Name="y" AttributeDataType="xs:double"><Value>-1.8</Value></Attribute>
        <Attribute Name="z" AttributeDataType="xs:double"><Value>0.0</Value></Attribute>
        <Attribute Name="rx" AttributeDataType="xs:double"><Value>0.0</Value></Attribute>
        <Attribute Name="ry" AttributeDataType="xs:double"><Value>0.0</Value></Attribute>
        <Attribute Name="rz" AttributeDataType="xs:double"><Value>45.0</Value></Attribute>
      </Attribute>
      <ExternalInterface Name="weldTrigger" ID="weld-rob-01-trig" RefBaseClassPath="AutomationMLInterfaceClassLib/AutomationMLBaseInterface/SignalInterface" Direction="In" DataType="BOOL" />
      <ExternalInterface Name="weldComplete" ID="weld-rob-01-done" RefBaseClassPath="AutomationMLInterfaceClassLib/AutomationMLBaseInterface/SignalInterface" Direction="Out" DataType="BOOL" />
      <ExternalInterface Name="currentActual" ID="weld-rob-01-curr" RefBaseClassPath="AutomationMLInterfaceClassLib/AutomationMLBaseInterface/SignalInterface" Direction="Out" DataType="REAL" />
      <RoleRequirements RefBaseRoleClassPath="AutomationMLBaseRoleClassLib/AutomationMLBaseRole/Resource" />
    </InternalElement>
    <InternalElement Name="BodyFixtureClamp" ID="clamp-01">
      <Attribute Name="Frame">
        <Attribute Name="x" AttributeDataType="xs:double"><Value>3.0</Value></Attribute>
        <Attribute Name="y" AttributeDataType="xs:double"><Value>0.0</Value></Attribute>
        <Attribute Name="z" AttributeDataType="xs:double"><Value>0.9</Value></Attribute>
        <Attribute Name="rx" AttributeDataType="xs:double"><Value>0.0</Value></Attribute>
        <Attribute Name="ry" AttributeDataType="xs:double"><Value>0.0</Value></Attribute>
        <Attribute Name="rz" AttributeDataType="xs:double"><Value>0.0</Value></Attribute>
      </Attribute>
      <ExternalInterface Name="clampCloseCmd" ID="clamp-01-cmd" RefBaseClassPath="AutomationMLInterfaceClassLib/AutomationMLBaseInterface/SignalInterface" Direction="In" DataType="BOOL" />
      <ExternalInterface Name="clampedOK" ID="clamp-01-ok" RefBaseClassPath="AutomationMLInterfaceClassLib/AutomationMLBaseInterface/SignalInterface" Direction="Out" DataType="BOOL" />
      <RoleRequirements RefBaseRoleClassPath="AutomationMLBaseRoleClassLib/AutomationMLBaseRole/Resource" />
    </InternalElement>
    <InternalElement Name="LineSafetyPLC" ID="plc-biw-01">
      <ExternalInterface Name="outClampClose" ID="plc-biw-01-clmp" RefBaseClassPath="AutomationMLInterfaceClassLib/AutomationMLBaseInterface/SignalInterface" Direction="Out" DataType="BOOL" />
      <ExternalInterface Name="inClampedOK" ID="plc-biw-01-clmp-ok" RefBaseClassPath="AutomationMLInterfaceClassLib/AutomationMLBaseInterface/SignalInterface" Direction="In" DataType="BOOL" />
      <ExternalInterface Name="outWeldStart" ID="plc-biw-01-weld" RefBaseClassPath="AutomationMLInterfaceClassLib/AutomationMLBaseInterface/SignalInterface" Direction="Out" DataType="BOOL" />
      <ExternalInterface Name="inWeldDone" ID="plc-biw-01-done" RefBaseClassPath="AutomationMLInterfaceClassLib/AutomationMLBaseInterface/SignalInterface" Direction="In" DataType="BOOL" />
      <ExternalInterface Name="inWeldCurrent" ID="plc-biw-01-curr" RefBaseClassPath="AutomationMLInterfaceClassLib/AutomationMLBaseInterface/SignalInterface" Direction="In" DataType="REAL" />
      <ExternalInterface Name="plcLogic" ID="plc-biw-01-st" RefBaseClassPath="AutomationMLInterfaceClassLib/AutomationMLBaseInterface/PLCopenXMLInterface" RefURI="plc_signals.st" />
      <InternalLink Name="ClampCmdLink" RefPartnerSideA="plc-biw-01:outClampClose" RefPartnerSideB="clamp-01:clampCloseCmd" />
      <InternalLink Name="ClampFbLink" RefPartnerSideA="clamp-01:clampedOK" RefPartnerSideB="plc-biw-01:inClampedOK" />
      <InternalLink Name="WeldTriggerLink" RefPartnerSideA="plc-biw-01:outWeldStart" RefPartnerSideB="weld-rob-01:weldTrigger" />
      <InternalLink Name="WeldDoneLink" RefPartnerSideA="weld-rob-01:weldComplete" RefPartnerSideB="plc-biw-01:inWeldDone" />
      <InternalLink Name="WeldCurrentLink" RefPartnerSideA="weld-rob-01:currentActual" RefPartnerSideB="plc-biw-01:inWeldCurrent" />
      <RoleRequirements RefBaseRoleClassPath="AutomationMLBaseRoleClassLib/AutomationMLBaseRole/Resource" />
    </InternalElement>
  </InstanceHierarchy>
</CAEXFile>

title: Smart Factory Virtual Commissioning Digital Twin (AML + Roles + Interfaces + URDF)
description: Multi-file IEC 62714 AutomationML smart-factory digital twin integrating an AGV material mover, 6-DOF robot workcell, optical quality station, and supervisory PLC with external RoleClassLib (roles.aml), InterfaceClassLib (interfaces.aml), and kinematic URDF model (robot_kinematics.urdf).

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<robot name="assembly_cell_arm">
  <link name="base_link">
    <inertial>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.15" rpy="0 0 0" />
      <mass value="28.0" />
      <inertia ixx="0.45" ixy="0" ixz="0" iyy="0.45" iyz="0" izz="0.32" />
    </inertial>
    <visual>
      <geometry><cylinder radius="0.18" length="0.30" /></geometry>
    </visual>
    <collision>
      <geometry><cylinder radius="0.18" length="0.30" /></geometry>
    </collision>
  </link>
  <link name="upper_arm">
    <inertial>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.35" rpy="0 0 0" />
      <mass value="12.5" />
      <inertia ixx="0.22" ixy="0" ixz="0" iyy="0.22" iyz="0" izz="0.06" />
    </inertial>
    <visual>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.35" rpy="0 0 0" />
      <geometry><box size="0.12 0.12 0.70" /></geometry>
    </visual>
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.35" rpy="0 0 0" />
      <geometry><box size="0.12 0.12 0.70" /></geometry>
    </collision>
  </link>
  <joint name="shoulder_yaw" type="revolute">
    <parent link="base_link" />
    <child link="upper_arm" />
    <origin xyz="0 0 0.30" rpy="0 0 0" />
    <axis xyz="0 0 1" />
    <limit lower="-3.14159" upper="3.14159" effort="180.0" velocity="2.5" />
  </joint>
</robot>
